queries: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet arxiv

sources_considered.why: A leading developer's own statement (Sept 2025) on whether hallucinations persist in its frontier models.

receipt.public_excerpt: GPT‑5 has significantly fewer hallucinations especially when reasoning⁠, but they still occur. Hallucinations remain a fundamental challenge for all large language models

evidence_items.explanation: As of September 2025, OpenAI says hallucinations remain a fundamental challenge for all LLMs. No decisive event contradicting the forecast had occurred, but this does not confirm 'never'.

unresolved_gaps: 'Never' cannot be confirmed by any finite date.
No accepted threshold exists for 'working reliably'.
